# Skill: Markdown & AI Watermark Validator

## Instructions for Agents
When creating or modifying any file inside the `artifacts/` folder, ensure:
1. The very first line of the file is: `<!-- Generated by GitHub Copilot Agentic SDLC Workflow -->`
2. The document contains clear markdown headers (`#`, `##`, `###`) corresponding to its SDLC phase.
3. No broken internal markdown links exist.
